title: Godzilla: Revenge of the Deadzone #2
desc:
The man with the skin of Godzilla…the woman with the eyes of Mothra.

Return to the Deadzone! With the Wanderer captured and brought to New York City, Glasseater and Runt are forced to seek shelter with their former captor: the leader of the Church of Godzilla, the woman with the eyes of Mothra, Mother A. In order to evade G-Force, they'll be forced to delve deeper and deeper into the center of the Deadzone…eventually coming face-to-face with the kaiju at its core.
